Consider the circle of radius $9$ centered at the origin, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $\theta \in [0,2\pi ),$  traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point $A(9,0)?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The parametric equations of a circle  of radius $r$ centered at  the origin are

$$
x=r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

Under this parametrization, the circle is traversed once in the counterclockwise direction, starting from $(r,0).$

In our case, the radius $r=9.$ Therefore, the parametric equations of the circle are 

$$
x=9\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=9\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$
